title: The Lotus Sutra (Fall Class Part 2)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up chapters 15 and 16 of the Lotus Sutra in Gene Reeves's translation, after opening with Dogen's "Only a Buddha and a Buddha" and its line on the self-power of jiriki and the other-power of tariki. Nomon compares several English renderings of the Chinese four-character phrase, then reads aloud with the class as bodhisattvas spring from the earth and Maitreya wonders how a Buddha of forty years could have taught them. The Buddha's answer is the parable of the physician whose poisoned children take the medicine only after hearing he has died. Participants share turning points, including a young woman sent back to San Francisco by Tartang Tulku, and Nomon offers historical, devotional, and practical ways to read the sutra's dizzying numbers.
